findings.title: Image missing alternative text
findings.reproduction: Open the file with a screen reader or validate it at https://validator.w3.org. The alt attribute is missing.
findings.evidence: has no alt attribute on line 29.
findings.recommendation: Add an alt attribute with a useful image description, for example: alt="Main portfolio image". If the image is purely decorative, use alt="".

findings.title: Internal link points to a missing destination
findings.reproduction: Follow the link or open contato.html from the site directory. The destination file does not exist.
findings.evidence: <a href="contato.html"> on line 17; the expected file at demo-site/contato.html was not found.
findings.recommendation: Create contato.html or update the href to point to an existing destination.
